audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 4/10, breakdown.difficulty 'Overall difficulty: 4/10' and report[14].t 'Favoured matchup' all say easy lane, while diff says HARD and the Emerald+ win rate is 46.77%.
audit.why: Renekton loses this matchup on average over 1144 games. The first three levels are genuinely his, but everything after is Kayle's, so a 4/10 'favoured' rating misrepresents the game the player is about to play.
audit.corrected: diffRating 6.5/10 with the difficulty and final-rating prose reworded to match diff HARD.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Renekton rows 3, 5 and 6 and Skill row 4, so the chart claims Renekton wins first item and two items against a scaling Kayle.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Renekton / Renekton / Renekton / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle and the mirror already flipped rows 3-6 to Kayle. The content whys[3..6] already describe Kayle winning each of those stages — only the side tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4, 5 and 6 set to Kayle in matched full/content pairs, ratings dropped to match, and the three full-layer whys that claimed Renekton pressure at those stages rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Celestial Blessing is labelled '(E)' in wants.foe[0] and called 'her Celestial Blessing E speed boost' in early; Starfire Spellblade's auto reset and missing-health scaling appear nowhere.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Celestial Blessing is W — heal plus move speed to herself and the nearest ally, flat 15s cooldown at every rank. Starfire Spellblade is E, an auto-attack reset whose bonus damage is proportionate to the target's MISSING health, so it hurts most exactly when you are trying to Q-heal back. Renekton's 50-Fury Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s and destroys damage shields. The flat 15s Celestial Blessing is the real punish trigger in lane, not her ultimate.
audit.corrected: Slot letter corrected to (W) in both places, the 15s window written in as the step-up trigger, and the auto reset plus missing-health scaling stated in spikes[2].

audit.why: Executioner's Calling is already named in report[8].t and breakdown.late, which satisfies the anti-heal requirement against Celestial Blessing; whys[2] and wants.you[1] now tie it to the 15s window so the timing is concrete.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her scaling starts: Radiant Blast's slow answers your E and Celestial Blessing heals off the chip. Bank CS, keep the wave short, buy anti-heal.

edits.before: Dominus stats turn even fights into wins before 25 minutes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Dominus is your last clean solo-kill window, but Divine Judgment negates the burst — bait the invulnerability, then re-engage as it drops.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Divine Judgment's cooldown.
edits.after: Her Nashor's spike beats your Eclipse — fight only with a jungler, never into her ranged form.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kayle carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on she out-ranges and out-DPSes you. Kayle carry threat 9.5/10 — close on objectives before her third item lands.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Divine Judgment and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6.5/10. Levels 1-3 are yours; everything after is decided by how much you banked before she scales.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 6.5/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.

edits.before: All three abilities online and she remains melee; your E lets you engage or disengage on your terms and Q sustain means you win extended short trades she tries to drag out.
edits.after: All three abilities online and she is still melee; Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal, so step up the moment it is spent and Grievous Wounds decides the long trade.

edits.before: Use E-in on her Q slow window ending — slice through her, empowered W, Q-heal back out before she can retaliate
edits.after: Step in the instant Celestial Blessing is spent — 15s down, and 50-Fury W stuns 1.5s through any shield

edits.before: Slow your E approach with Celestial Blessing (E) movement speed and Q slow so your W whiffs or lands non-empowered
edits.after: Kite on Celestial Blessing (W) speed and Radiant Blast's slow, then reset an auto with Starfire Spellblade's missing-health hit

edits.before: Kayle hits ranged form at level 6 and her Q slow lets her kite your E; by level 11 her passive flame waves and Nashor's Tooth DPS outpace your Q heal, so the 1v1 flips hard.
edits.after: Kayle hits ranged form and Radiant Blast's slow kites your E; Starfire Spellblade resets her auto and scales on your MISSING health, so every trade she starts snowballs itself.

edits.before: Kayle is melee range and fragile through level 5 — treat this as a free farm window only if you respect her passive stacks. At level 1 she out-sustains poke with her W heal, so don't waste autos trying to chip her down without a full combo ready. Hit level 2 first from the three-minion wave and immediately E-in, empowered W-stun, Q-heal out — she has no mobility to escape and her Celestial Blessing E speed boost won't save her from a point-and-click stun landing before she activates it. Keep the wave slow-pushed toward your side so she must walk into your engage range; if she freezes on you, crash the wave and dive with Dominus HP backing you.
edits.after: Kayle is melee range and fragile through level 5 — treat this as a free farm window only if you respect her passive stacks. At level 1 she out-sustains poke with Celestial Blessing, so don't chip at her without a full combo ready. Hit level 2 first from the three-minion wave and immediately E-in, empowered W-stun, Q-heal out — she has no mobility, and Celestial Blessing (W) is a flat 15s cooldown whose speed boost cannot save her from a point-and-click 1.5s stun. Keep the wave slow-pushed toward your side so she must walk into your engage range; if she freezes on you, crash the wave and dive with Dominus HP backing you.
